scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of finite policy optimality and phase limits; standalone small-case computational checks; novelty comparisons include an explicitly inaccessible primary text.
scientific_limitations: Balanced complete bipartite graphs and history-based per-step steering only; exact finite laws for all eps in [0,1] but asymptotic claims only for eps tending to zero. No extension to general graphs or quantitative rates; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Sharp cover-time laws and a log-gamma-to-Gaussian transition for steered bipartite walks
